arabic text:
ZAINAB KA TUJHSAY WADA HAI BHAI, DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA
BEWARSI HO YA BE RIDAYEE..
DUNIYA MEY TERA MATAM RAHEYGA..
english translation text:
Zainab promises you, my brother: your matam
will remain in this world. Whether I
am left without support or without a veil,
your matam will remain in this world.

arabic text:
PARCHAM UTHAKAR GHAZI KA APNA,
PUREY KARONGI MEY TEREY WAADEY..
BABA KARENGEY MUSHKIL KUSHAI…. DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA
english translation text:
I will raise Ghazi’s standard and
fulfil every promise I made to
you. Father will remove every difficulty—your
matam will remain in this world.

arabic text:
PAIGHAM TERA MITNEY NA DOONGI..
PYAASI RAHUNGEE, PEDAL CHALONGEE..
MAZLOOMEEYAT KI BANKAR GAWAHEE, DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA
english translation text:
I will not let your message be
erased. I will remain thirsty and walk
on foot. Bearing witness to your oppression,
your matam will remain in this world.

arabic text:
AUDHONGI SAR PAR US WAQT CHADAR,
LE LOONGI BADLA JAB AEY BARADAR..
KEHTI HAI TUJHSEY ZEHRA KI JAAYEE.. DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA
english translation text:
I will place a veil upon my head
only then, when I have taken revenge, O
brother. The daughter of Zahra says to
you: your matam will remain in this world.

arabic text:
BETO KA MATAM US DIN KAROONGI,
CHEHLUM TUMHARA JAB KAR CHUKUNGI..
MAINEY YAHI HAI MANNAT UTHAAYEE… DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA
english translation text:
I will mourn my sons on that
day, after I have completed your chehlum.
This is the vow I have made:
your matam will remain in this world.

arabic text: CHADAR KAY BADLAY SAR LOONGI USKA,\nMAJLIS KI KHATIR GHAR LOONGI USKA..
english translation text: In exchange for my veil, I will take his head;\nfor the sake of the majlis, I will take his house.

arabic text: NASLEY YAZEEDI (LA) DEYGI DUHAYEE, DUNIYA MEY\nTERA MATAM RAHEYGA
english translation text: The descendants of Yazid will cry out in anguish;\nyour matam will remain in this world.

arabic text:
ZAINAB KA TUJHSAY WADA HAI BHAI, DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA..
HAR GHAR MEY HOGA AB TERA MATAM,
HAR ROZ HOGA MISLEY MOHARRAM...
DEKHEYGI AB TO SAARI KHUDAAYEE.. DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA
english translation text:
Zainab promises you, my brother: your
matam will remain in this world. Your
matam will be held in every
home; every day will become like
Muharram. All creation will witness it: your
matam will remain in this world.

arabic text:
TAABOOT TERA GHAZI KA PARCHAM,
UTHTEY RAHEYENGEY DUNIYA MEY HAR DAM..
MAINEY KHASAM HAI ZEHRA KI KHAYEE,, DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA
english translation text:
Your taboot and Ghazi’s standard will
continue to be raised throughout the
world. I have sworn by Zahra: your
matam will remain in this world.

arabic text:
RAB KI RAZA HAI REHAN NAUHA,
NA QAIDE MAUSAM NA QAUF E DUNIYA..
YE NAUKRI HAI QISMAT SEY PAAYEE.. DUNIYA MEY
TERA MATAM RAHEYGA
english translation text:
This lament, Rehan, is by God’s pleasure—
not bound by season, nor afraid of
the world. This service was granted by destiny:
your matam will remain in this world.

arabic text: ZAINAB KA TUJHSAY WADA HAI BHAI, DUNIYA MEY\nTERA MATAM RAHEYGA..
english translation text: Zainab promises you, my brother: your\nmatam will remain in this world.
